cases.input: Generate a consistent explanatory image from the approved visual plan and DESIGN.md for a spatial concept, with clear provenance and intended meaning.
requiredBehaviors: tie the image to prioritized learning claims and the visual plan
follow the active DESIGN.md across style perspective contrast and color
mark generated images as illustrative-only in the manifest
forbiddenBehaviors: present a generated illustration as experimental or photographic evidence
hallucinate confidential logos product shapes or brand features

cases.input: A learning visual needs several precise labels and a small amount of explanatory text; the requested bitmap would make the text unreadable on mobile.
requiredBehaviors: prefer overlay text or SVG/HTML/PPTX text when labels should remain crisp
keep the generated image focused on explanatory visual content
record intended meaning and prohibited interpretations
forbiddenBehaviors: bake unreadable critical text into the raster image
use image generation for a text-heavy diagram better served by SVG
skillAnchors: Kritische Labels/Text nicht in das Rasterbild backen

cases.input: A generated image adds an unverified instrument component, recreates a corporate logo and is captioned as a photograph from the experiment.
requiredBehaviors: reject confidential or invented brand reconstruction
forbiddenBehaviors: copy the source video's visual expression as closely as possible
